title: Catalog
description: The slice of the semantic model the front end needs: names, and the properties that drive presentation.

unit.description: What the metric is measured in, which is how its values are written. "ratio" is a rate from 0 to 1 and "percent" one from 0 to 100; "ms" and "s" are lengths of time. Money's unit is its currency's ISO 4217 code in lower case, "usd", and its values are in that currency's own units: dollars, not cents.

definition.description: What the number counts, caveats included, in a sentence or two. Carried with the tldr value, and shown when the number is pointed at.

polarity.description: Whether an increase is good. Drives delta colour.

rangeTotal.description: How the engine forms a total over a range.

instant.description: No range and no prior period, such as people present now.

domain.description: The range a value is read against, least then most: the two ends of a gauge.

bands.description: Where the domain is divided, in ascending order: each is where one band ends and the next begins.

type.description: "number" is a quantity the engine bins or samples along. A row holds where its bin starts, and where it ends as "<dimension>@end".

values.description: What the values are codes of. "country" is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in capitals, written as the country's name.
